test_title: PYST 50: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

Some tables are plates.

Some tables are spoons.

Conclusions:

(I) At least some spoons are plates.

(II) Some plates are tables.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c64807ce5f0e8c0104aa83c1662265e61b435dfc25af473fc16f1121e59ce76.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fbba01fa7e99247f0b6a48e06417d02e77558f9a5f2b5b2003329713ff6a46e.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) At least some spoons are plates → False(As, there is no direct relation between spoons and plates. so, it can be a possibility but not definite)

(II) Some plates are tables → **True**(As, Some tables are plates. so, Some plates are tables holds true)

Thus, Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
